enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Breathes in. Breathes out. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Extends left arm. Bends right leg. Turns onto back. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Lies still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Lifts toilet seat. Urinates. Flushes toilet. Lowers toilet seat. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Picks up soap. Rubs hands and face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns on tap. Rinses toothbrush. Turns off tap. Puts down toothbrush. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread. Takes out butter. Closes refrigerator. Places bread slices in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Opens cupboard. Takes out mug. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Presses kettle switch. Waits. Toaster pops up. Removes toast. Places toast on plate. Spreads butter on toast. Pours boiling water into mug. Adds tea bag. Stirs tea. Sits at table. Eats toast. Drinks tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Closes wardrobe. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens drawer. Takes out belt. Puts on belt. Opens backpack. Places laptop in backpack. Places notebook in backpack. Places pen in backpack. Places water bottle in backpack. Zips backpack. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Puts phone in pocket. Picks up keys. Puts keys in pocket. Turns off fan. Exits bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks to office building. Enters building. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Waits for elevator. Enters elevator. Presses floor button. Elevator stops. Exits elevator. Walks to office door. Opens door. Enters office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails, and preparing workshop materials
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email program. Reads emails. Types replies. Sends emails. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Makes phone calls. Speaks on phone. Writes notes. Opens document. Edits document. Prints document. Prepares workshop materials. Sorts papers. Staples papers. Puts materials in folder. Places folder in bag. Arranges desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to lunch spot. Enters cafe. Orders food. Pays cashier. Receives food. Finds table. Sits down. Unwraps food. Picks up fork. Eats food. Drinks water. Wipes mouth with napkin. Throws trash in bin. Stands up. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: meeting with partner organizations and organizing upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Enters meeting room. Greets partners. Shakes hands. Sits at table. Opens laptop. Projects presentation. Discusses plans. Takes notes. Listens. Nods. Speaks. Answers questions. Closes laptop. Stands up. Shakes hands. Exits meeting room. Returns to desk. Opens calendar. Schedules events. Calls venues. Sends emails. Updates spreadsheets. Organizes files. Leaves office.

Walks to bus stop. Waits. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Places bag on lap. Looks out window. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to exit. Steps off bus. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters home.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out meat. Closes refrigerator. Places vegetables on cutting board. Picks up knife. Cuts vegetables. Opens cupboard. Takes out pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Pours oil into pan. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds meat. Stirs. Adds spices. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up dishes. Scrapes food into trash. Opens dishwasher. Places dishes in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Picks up sponge. Wets sponge. Applies soap. Wipes counter. Rinses sponge. Wipes counter again. Dries counter with towel. Turns off light. Exits kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rubs body. Rinses. Applies shampoo. Rubs scalp. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Turns on light. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Changes channels. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to couch. Sits down. Drinks. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Turns off light. Exits living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the computer and phone, reading, and setting out clothes for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on light. Sits on bed. Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Types. Uses phone. Reads book. Puts down book. Opens wardrobe. Takes out clothes for tomorrow. Places clothes on chair. Turns off computer. Turns off light. Lies down. Closes eyes.

Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Breathes in. Breathes out. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Extends left arm. Bends right leg. Turns onto back. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Lies still.
